cases.name: Separate a memory and a wish
cases.prompt: I took a ferry in May and kept the ticket. I hope to return in winter. Organize this.
expectations: Creates a past journey entry for the ferry.
Creates a linked keepsake entry for the ticket.
Does not mark the winter trip booked or completed.

cases.name: Missing calendar
cases.prompt: I have a 3 pm museum booking and want a market detour before it. There is no connected calendar or route.
expectations: Places the museum under itinerary planning.
Treats the market as an optional detour.
Asks for the starting point or available travel window.
Keeps actual reservations and navigation outside the generated plan.

cases.name: Public memory collection
cases.prompt: Make a shareable page about last week's family trip from these notes. Leave out names and our address. We bought a shell postcard.
expectations: Uses an anonymous family trip label.
Creates a memento entry for the postcard.
Omits personal names and the address.
Does not invent details of the purchase or photo.
